A message for Sparkle 💗

Dear Sparkle, Happy birthday to my favourite girl. If our memories were an album, I would keep every edition. The little laughs, the ordinary days that turned into favourite stories, and all the moments that make life feel brighter — I would save them all. I hope your new year is full of golden surprises, brave new beginnings, beautiful adventures and the kind of happiness that stays long after the music ends. Keep being wonderfully you. Happy birthday. Here is to your next beautiful era. ♡ With all my love
